entities.name: Flogging & Whipping
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The most universal corporal punishment in human history. Roman soldiers were flogged with the flagellum (metal-tipped whip). Medieval courts prescribed specific numbers of lashes. British naval discipline used the cat-o'-nine-tails — 250 lashes could kill. Flogging was used on slaves, soldiers, prisoners, and schoolchildren worldwide.
